articles.title: Why we built our own apps instead of buying more tools
articles.summary: Thirteen years of taking companies into the U.S. taught us where growth really leaks. So we built the apps to plug each leak, and turned them into a team of AI agents.

articles.title: ICP: your U.S. market launch analysis in minutes, not months
articles.summary: Enter a website. Get a 12-point U.S. launch analysis: who buys, who you compete with, where to meet them and how to reach them.

articles.title: Events: stop flying to the wrong U.S. trade shows
articles.summary: From your ideal customer profile to a graded calendar of U.S. events, plus the exhibitors and CEOs worth meeting at each one.

articles.title: Publish: a LinkedIn presence your U.S. buyers recognise before you write to them
articles.summary: Create, approve, schedule and publish LinkedIn posts in your voice, with a client validation step before anything goes live.

articles.title: Social: know which content earns attention before you post more
articles.summary: LinkedIn analytics and social performance dashboards that track reach, engagement and the inbound signals that matter.

articles.title: Pulse: no hot lead waits in a LinkedIn inbox again
articles.summary: LinkedIn and Sales Navigator inbox triage. Every conversation sorted Red, Orange or Green, so the interested prospects get an answer first.

articles.title: Radar: the warm intro beats the cold message
articles.summary: Warm introductions, mapped: Sources, Bridges, Prospects. See who in your network can introduce you to each buyer.

articles.title: Sales: no deal dies of silence
articles.summary: A follow-up copilot on the sales pipeline. It surfaces every deal that needs a nudge and drafts the next touch.

articles.title: Client and Report: proof, every week, on one page
articles.summary: A client portal with live dashboards and a one-pager generator that turns a month of campaign data into a client-ready report.

articles.title: Talking Points: walk into every meeting prepared
articles.summary: AI-assisted talking points and messaging guidance for sharper client and prospect conversations.

articles.title: Welcome: onboarding as a conversation, not a form
articles.summary: Conversational client onboarding that captures context, goals and requirements in one structured flow.

articles.title: Gauge: how good are you really with Sales Navigator?
articles.summary: Sign in with LinkedIn and get a score that shows how well you use Sales Navigator, and what to improve first.

articles.title: Tools: are you getting what you pay for from your growth stack?
articles.summary: One score for every growth tool you pay for: how well each outreach and AI platform is really being used.

articles.title: Linalysis: LinkedIn analytics that span years, not snapshots
articles.summary: Connections, profile views, Social Selling Index and company pages, tracked over the long term so you can see what really moves.

articles.title: NexaShare: make sure the right people see what you publish
articles.summary: LinkedIn content amplification: get your team and network to repost and react to what you publish, at the moment it counts.

articles.title: Gershon MCP: your AI assistant, plugged into your U.S. campaign
articles.summary: One connector that lets Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini read Gershon's platforms through safe, read-only actions.
